experimental_design.hypothesis: A WSL2 Linux-native environment removes Windows-specific tool and credential visibility failures while preserving explicit Codex safety approvals.
changed_variables: Operating environment: native Windows to WSL2 Ubuntu
Repository filesystem: NTFS workspace to ext4 under /home
Toolchain: Windows aliases/private paths to WSL-native tools
Credential boundary: host keyring dependency to WSL-local gh login
controlled_variables: Same repository project and CI-equivalent validation commands
No Task #65 candidate implementation in this Task
No final Rules or Runner implementation
No raw credentials or rollouts committed
prohibited_confounders: Claiming Token effects from environment diagnostics
Adding broad Rules to force direct success
Executing Task #65 candidate before the candidate control plane is frozen
expected_effects: Fewer Windows-specific executable and credential visibility failures
A reproducible environment contract for later Runner and Rules Tasks
observed_effects: WSL-native tools and ext4 repository were usable
Formal Git metadata, user cache and GitHub network still required approval

cases.title: GitHub 认证失败与恢复
cases.trigger: gh auth status showed no logged-in host and HTTPS fetch could not obtain credentials.
timeline: Initial diagnostic: gh and Git fetch failed.
WSL-local gh login and Git integration were configured.
Repository, Issue and PR reads passed.
Formal fetch passed through the approved path.
cases.observed_behavior: Network and TLS were available, but authenticated Git/GitHub operations failed until WSL-local login existed.
cases.diagnosis: Authentication, network and Git metadata permissions were separate failure domains.
cases.response: Use a revocable WSL-local gh login; do not copy the Windows credential directory.
cases.outcome: GitHub read and formal fetch became available, with approval retained.
cases.generalizable_lesson: Diagnose network, authentication and repository metadata separately.
cases.project_specific_limit: The exact scopes and approval routing remain repository-specific.

evidence_refs.locator: WSL2 Codex 能力与审批矩阵

cases.title: uv 版本漂移与恢复
cases.trigger: Local uv 0.12.0 differed from CI uv 0.11.28.
cases.observed_behavior: The project worked, but reproducibility was not satisfied.
cases.diagnosis: Functional success did not prove version parity.
cases.response: Pin uv to the CI version.
cases.outcome: Local and CI tool contracts aligned.
cases.generalizable_lesson: A reproducible environment needs version identity, not merely successful execution.
cases.project_specific_limit: Future upgrades require a coordinated CI and documentation change.

cases.title: WSL2 改善工具可见性但不消除 approval
cases.trigger: The migration was expected to remove many environment failures.
timeline: Formal Git metadata and GitHub network required approval.
cases.observed_behavior: OS-native tools were visible, while sandbox boundaries remained.
cases.diagnosis: The operating-system boundary and Codex sandbox boundary are independent.
cases.response: Classify the environment as ready-with-gaps and preserve exact approvals.
cases.outcome: The workflow is usable without claiming an approval-free environment.
cases.generalizable_lesson: Platform migration is not a substitute for permission design.
cases.project_specific_limit: Exact approval routes depend on current Codex policies.

evidence_refs.locator: WSL2 Codex 能力与审批矩阵

cases.title: 裸 python 缺失但 Python 环境完整
cases.trigger: The bare python command was missing.
timeline: uv run python and all project validations passed.
cases.diagnosis: System and project Python entry points were valid.
cases.response: Use python3 for bootstrap and uv run python for project work.
cases.generalizable_lesson: Validate supported entry points rather than a single command name.
cases.project_specific_limit: A future third-party tool may explicitly require python.

cases.title: 可逆 GitHub 写权限探针
cases.trigger: GitHub write scope needed validation without creating an Issue or PR.
timeline: Create a unique temporary remote ref.
Verify no remote ref or PR remained.
cases.observed_behavior: The operation succeeded after approval and cleaned fully.
cases.diagnosis: A Git ref was the smallest reversible object for this permission test.
cases.response: Require an explicit confirmation string and unique probe name.
cases.outcome: Write capability was verified with no persistent side effect.
cases.generalizable_lesson: Prefer unique, reversible and independently verifiable permission probes.
cases.project_specific_limit: Repository protection rules may differ on other repositories.

evidence_refs.locator: CLI profiles and write-probe confirmation handling

cases.title: 无代理访问仅部分成功
cases.trigger: Proxy variables were temporarily removed in child processes.
cases.observed_behavior: One endpoint succeeded while the complete workflow did not.
cases.diagnosis: Endpoint-level success could not be generalized to GitHub workflow availability.
cases.response: Keep proxy + approval as the supported path and classify no-proxy as partial.
cases.outcome: The workflow avoids an unreliable direct-network dependency.
cases.generalizable_lesson: Test network capability by endpoint and protocol.
cases.project_specific_limit: Results may vary with ISP, DNS and proxy state.

decisions.question: Which environment should be the supported Codex development target?
options_considered: Continue repairing native Windows sandbox compatibility
Adopt WSL2 Ubuntu with Linux-native tools
decisions.selected_option: Adopt WSL2 Ubuntu with Linux-native tools
rejected_options: Continue repairing WindowsApps, WinGet-private path and host-keyring compatibility as the long-term path
decisions.rationale: The WSL2 diagnostic verified native tool paths, ext4 repository use and direct temporary Git while keeping remaining approval boundaries explicit.

evidence_refs.locator: WSL2 Codex 能力与审批矩阵

decisions.rollback_trigger: WSL2 cannot meet reliability, performance or compatibility requirements.

decisions.question: Where should the repository live?
rejected_options: Use /mnt/c or /mnt/d as the default development path
decisions.rationale: Linux filesystem semantics reduce cross-platform permission, case and file-mode ambiguity.
decisions.rollback_trigger: The WSL filesystem becomes unavailable or lacks sufficient capacity.

decisions.question: Should the environment add a global python alias?
options_considered: Use python3 and uv run python
Install python-is-python3 or create a global symlink
decisions.selected_option: Use python3 and uv run python
rejected_options: Add global alias state without a demonstrated requirement
decisions.rationale: The verified system and project entry points already cover all commands.
decisions.rollback_trigger: A required, non-configurable tool explicitly requires the bare python command.

decisions.question: How should uv be versioned?
options_considered: Use the newest local uv release
decisions.rationale: Version parity is part of the reproducibility contract.
decisions.rollback_trigger: A coordinated CI upgrade or required security fix.

decisions.question: How should GitHub credentials be provided in WSL?
options_considered: Copy the Windows credential directory or depend on host keyring visibility
decisions.rationale: The selected option is independently revocable and has a clear credential boundary.

evidence_refs.locator: WSL2 Codex 能力与审批矩阵

decisions.rollback_trigger: Credential leakage, excessive scope or login invalidation.

decisions.question: Which network path is supported for formal GitHub operations?
rejected_options: Treat partial no-proxy success as a workflow guarantee
decisions.rationale: No-proxy access was partial while the approved proxy path passed.
decisions.rollback_trigger: Proxy configuration or network policy changes and a new diagnostic validates another path.

decisions.question: Should this Task configure broad Rules to remove approvals?
options_considered: Record the boundary and defer minimum-permission Rules
Add broad Rules until diagnostics pass directly
decisions.selected_option: Record the boundary and defer minimum-permission Rules
rejected_options: Widen permissions merely to make the environment appear fully green
decisions.rationale: This Task measures the boundary; the following Rules Task must independently validate exact command and path grants.

decisions.rollback_trigger: The later Rules audit shows that proposed grants are too broad or unstable.

charts.title: WSL2 capability classifications
charts.counting_rule: One row per capability category; repeated commands and diagnostic runs are not counted again.

research_notes.cohort: One WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 environment on one maintainer machine; three diagnostic rounds.
research_notes.comparability: Environment capability comparison only. It is not a Task #65 Token experiment result.
incomparability_factors: Different operating-system and control-plane conditions are intentionally changed variables
Network and proxy service state can vary over time
Raw Windows and WSL rollout command counts are not normalized in this Task
counterintuitive_findings: WSL2 did not remove Codex sandbox approvals
A missing bare python command did not mean Python was absent
One successful no-proxy API endpoint did not imply complete no-proxy GitHub access
generalizable_principles: Separate OS/tool visibility from sandbox permission boundaries
Separate network, authentication and Git metadata failure domains
Use reversible, unique and cleanup-verified write probes
Record unknown and not-measured fields instead of inferring them
project_specific_limits: uv 0.11.28 and Python 3.11 are current repository contracts
The repository currently relies on a machine-local proxy path
Exact Guardian routing is authoritative only in outer Codex rollout evidence
rejected_hypotheses: Migrating to WSL2 automatically removes all approval requirements
Bare python is required for this project
Partial no-proxy success is sufficient for formal workflow use
remaining_unknowns: Final minimum-permission Rules safety and effectiveness
